## 2. Supported findings (from the one verified source)

Single verified quantitative source: Bisinfotech, "Global Semiconductor Market Surges Beyond USD 1.5 Trillion in 2026 Driven by Extraordinary Memory Expansion," 2026-06-02, reporting the WSTS Spring 2026 forecast. URL: https://www.bisinfotech.com/global-semiconductor-market-surges-beyond-usd-1-5-trillion-in-2026-driven-by-extraordinary-memory-expansion/

1. Global semiconductor market forecast to grow ~90% in 2026 to USD 1.51tn (2025: USD 795.6bn, +26.2%); 2027 forecast +27% to ~USD 1.9tn.
2. Growth is overwhelmingly memory-driven: memory +249.5% YoY in 2026 to >USD 800bn; +32% in 2027. Logic +37% (2026), +27% (2027).
3. Regional concentration: Americas +112%, Asia Pacific +87.4%, Europe +58.4%, Japan +27.6% in 2026.
4. Non-AI categories grow far more slowly (analog +10%, micro +20%, discrete +8%, sensors +3%, optoelectronics +3% in 2026), implying a narrow, memory/AI-led upcycle.

**Caveat:** this is a forecast, not actuals; it is a secondary report of WSTS data; the primary WSTS release was not fetched; it is ~5 months old relative to 2026-11-15.

---

## 3. Risk verdict (from risk_assessment.md, task-c000aa3bd18747f7 — done)

Rated HIGH: R1 cyclicality/memory-cycle reversal [evidenced+judgment]; R2 concentration [evidenced+judgment]; R3 geopolitics/export controls [judgment — unsourced]; R4 valuation/positioning [judgment — unsourced].
Rated MEDIUM/MEDIUM-HIGH: R5 single-source/stale forecast [evidenced]; R6 capex/oversupply [judgment — unsourced]; R7 liquidity/suitability [judgment — unsourced].

Suitability: **cannot be affirmed on current evidence** — no client mandate/horizon/risk-tolerance provided, and material data gaps remain. Sector profile described as high-risk, high-concentration, late-cycle-shaped; potentially suitable only as a small satellite for a risk-tolerant, long-horizon client.

Monitoring triggers defined (T1 memory pricing turn; T2 forecast revision; T3 capex acceleration; T4 policy shock; T5 valuation stretch; T6 inventory/book-to-bill). T3–T6 are unbaselined — no data obtained.

3. Commission the independent review (task-d2dafb0100ff4d1e) to check every substantive slide against cited sources and preserve the evidenced/judgment distinction.
4. Package the deck with a README (open/present instructions) as a runnable delivery.
